sources.title: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner (CLF-C02) Exam Guide
sources.summary: Official exam blueprint for CLF-C02 domains, weights, task statements, candidate profile, scoring, and delivery facts.

extracted_facts.fact: The CLF-C02 exam guide defines four weighted domains: Cloud Concepts, Security and Compliance, Cloud Technology and Services, and Billing, Pricing, and Support.
The Cloud Practitioner exam is 90 minutes with 65 questions and a passing score of 700 on a 100-1000 scale.

exam_relevance.why_it_matters: Primary source for exam scope, domain weights, and exam metadata.
exam_relevance.separation_note: CLF-C02-only mapping for Cloud Practitioner domains; do not reuse for AIF-C01 without a separate AI Practitioner record.
